emotional_tone: Calm, reassuring, transparent, and approachable — feels like modern small-business insurance, not an intimidating Wall Street trading terminal

mono_numeric.usage: For market prices, contract payouts, percentage hedges, probability odds, and live countdown timers

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: High Density & Scannable Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4)
spacing_and_layout.border_padding: Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding to avoid text collision

surfaces_and_effects.header_nav: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 z-50 sticky top-0)
surfaces_and_effects.cards: Clean flat cards with crisp 1px stroke (border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow)
surfaces_and_effects.badges: Rounded pill status badges (e.g. bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800)

key_features_layout.landing_page: Hero section explaining rain/weather hedging with plain English diagram, Google Sign-In CTA, visual comparison (Unprotected vs RainCheck Protected), live sample Kalshi contracts ticker
key_features_layout.ai_onboarding: 1-Sentence input modal/page ('We are an artisanal ice cream shop in Austin with $45k summer monthly revenue'). AI parses city, climate sensitivity, revenue risk, and auto-generates profile
key_features_layout.ai_risk_report: Visual weather hazard breakdown with 1-3 tailored Kalshi market hedges (e.g., 'Austin Precip > 0.5 in on Summer Weekends'), confidence score, and projected revenue protection
key_features_layout.weather_market_browser: Filter by location, weather condition (Rain, Heatwave, Cold Snap, Snow), payout odds, settlement dates, with explicit Kalshi settlement rules in plain English tooltips
key_features_layout.hedge_calculator: Interactive slider for Coverage Level (25% to 100%), auto-calculating Premium Cost, Maximum Kalshi Payout, Net Revenue Offset, and Break-Even Weather Threshold
key_features_layout.execution_modal: Choice between 'Paper Trade (Sandbox)' and 'Execute on Kalshi (Live)'. Clear confirmation flow showing exact contract count, limit price, total cost, and max payout
key_features_layout.hedge_dashboard: Protected Revenue Gauge, Total Premium Spent, Total Payouts Collected, Active Weather Contracts List, Weather Alert Feed, Live Settlement Tracker
key_features_layout.kalshi_settings: Toggle between Kalshi Demo & Live API, API Key / Secret configuration with status validation indicator

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, sliders, modals, table rows) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='coverage-slider', data-testid='place-kalshi-trade-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: All text elements must meet WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text). Explicit hover states with matching high-contrast text colors
testing_and_accessibility.animations: Micro-interactions using Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions. All animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion

instructions_to_main_agent: Use plain, human-friendly financial language across the application (e.g. 'Insurance Protection', 'Payout', 'Weather Event', 'Cost per Contract') while providing inline explainers for Kalshi terms ('YES price', 'Settlement Date').

Ensure the application comes with realistic, rich pre-filled demo data (Austin Ice Cream Shop, Miami Beach Cafe, Seattle Rooftop Bar) so users can immediately experience onboarding, AI risk analysis, hedge calculation, and market execution.
Support both Paper Trading (risk-free sandbox mode) and Kalshi Live API mode with clear visual badges so users never get confused about execution state.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for order placements, API key updates, and profile generation feedback.
Add responsive mobile layout with drawer/collapsible navigation and clean high-density metrics grids.
